title: Chapter 281
text:
One.

After dealing with the rewards, Bennett sat down and said in a deep voice, "A war of this level will not happen again in the short term. However, after the Six Nations recover, they may start to deal with the other forces and continue to consolidate their rule. After the Germinal Organization is defeated, the Dark Net is one of the largest organizations left. They will deal with us sooner or later."

Han Xiao put away his excitement and put on a contemplative expression. "Before you have the right to speak, everyone thinks they are good people. However, the Six Nations still have to deal with the aftermath of the nuclear explosion in the short term. They won't have time to do anything else. Speaking of disasters, your shelter plan can come in handy."

Bennett sighed. "I would rather it never come in handy. After the war, there will be more wanderers from the outside world seeking shelter. I plan to speed up the plan and build shelters in the Western and Northern Continents. The refugees in Andrea need to be moved. I will also send people to receive them. The Six Nations are very willing to leave this mess to us."

Blue Star had two main main storylines. One was the Germinal Organization, which had been destroyed by him. This was the main conflict. The second was the construction of shelters. Compared to the Germinal Organization war, the shelter main storyline was not as intense. The entire Blue Star would enter a stable period. There would not be any large-scale conflicts in Version 1.0. Han Xiao's strength stood at the top of the planet, and he was the one who destroyed the Germinal Organization. He basically had no enemies, so he could develop steadily.

The Germinal Organization main storyline was supposed to be a major event throughout Version 1.0, where the players could show off their skills. However, it was gone in the early stages, so they could only do small things in the future. Players with chaotic tendencies naturally did not like peace, but it was a good thing for Han Xiao. He had just obtained the right to create a dungeon for the Germinal Organization main storyline. He could split the war into many dungeons to satisfy the players' inextinguishable desire for battle. He could attract more players to his side and continue to increase his status.

The Germinal Organization has been destroyed. I have no enemies in Blue Star, so I can prepare to go to the galaxy with peace of mind. The opportunity to leave Blue Star happens to be during the Pro League, which is close to a year later. This period of time will be very stable. I need to accumulate a lot of experience. After all, there are not many players in the galaxy for me to interact with.

Now that the enemy was gone, Han Xiao felt as if his tense nerves had finally relaxed.

Version 1.0 would last for three and a half years, and they could definitely afford to wait for a year. Right now, the Six Nations were immersed in the joy of victory and did not know that a calamity would soon befall them. The climate disaster caused by the nuclear explosion would probably increase the strength of the Mutation Disaster, and Han Xiao could only mourn for them.

Over the next few days, Han Xiao participated in a high-level meeting of the Dark Net to discuss their future.

He was mainly a bystander and did not express his opinion. However, none of the upper echelons present dared to ignore him. As the current most powerful person in the Dark Net and the biggest culprit behind the destruction of the Germinal Organization, Han Xiao's fame and status had broken through the sky. The intelligence agencies of the Six Nations had taken the initiative to commend him. With this achievement, Han Xiao would be respected everywhere. If he returned to Stardragon now, he would also receive the same treatment.

On the players' forums, the end of the main storyline had attracted a lot of attention. All kinds of discussion posts flooded the forums. It was the first time that the players had participated in such a big event, and they could not help but be excited. Some players who had witnessed the nuclear explosion with their own eyes posted videos, which attracted a lot of attention. After creating such a huge scene, the players could not forget about Han Xiao after the opening ceremony. Their imaginations ran wild, and they came up with even more bizarre stories, increasing Han Xiao's fame once again.

After the war ended, the Germinal Organization players lost their faction and had the chance to choose again. They could leave Andrea together with the refugees and choose which continent to go to. Almost seventy percent of the former Germinal Organization players chose the Southern Continent without hesitation.

Black Phantom, we are here!

The former Germinal Organization players were so happy that they almost cried. After suffering for so long, they could finally make a comeback. Who could understand the bitterness they felt every time they saw players from other continents showing off the benefits of Han Xiao?

Why did not all the former Germinal Organization players come?

Hmm … a large portion of the remaining thirty percent had participated in the mission of the Germinal Organization headquarters. Han Xiao's initial favorability with them was more than ten points, and they were in despair.

Trash Germinal Organization, give me back my future!

…

The helicopter landed in Sanctuary Three. As soon as he got off the helicopter, Huang Yu came over and stopped.

"What's wrong?" Han Xiao noticed Huang Yu's hesitation.

Huang Yu coughed and said, "Your Excellency, your family is here to visit you."

My family? Han Xiao was stunned for a moment before realizing that it was the Overmera family.

Thinking about it carefully, after the war ended, he was an internal member of the Overmera, and he was currently the most important person in the world. The Overmera was naturally curious about his attitude and wanted to use this relationship to get on his good side.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and said, "Let him see me."

Ten minutes later, Xiao Quan followed Huang Yu to the guest hall. He was the ambassador sent by the Overmera to visit Han Xiao, one of the adopted sons of Xiao Jin, and also the original brother of this body of Han Xiao. He could be considered as the so-called 'family'.

Xiao Quan was more outstanding among the adopted sons, and he was chosen as the ambassador because he knew how to judge the situation. When Han Xiao's real identity was exposed, many of the brothers in the family were in disbelief. Some of them were very angry when they thought that Han Xiao had become their elder and taken advantage of them. However, Xiao Quan did not dare to have such emotions. He was very clear about the current situation, and he could not judge the current 'Han Xiao' with the same standards as before. Every time he thought of the angry faces of the other brothers, Xiao Quan felt that they did not know what was good for them.

Black Phantom alone was far more powerful than the entire Overmera, so he did not dare to underestimate him.

Xiao Quan used his eloquence to talk to Huang Yu, wanting to find out Han Xiao's attitude. Huang Yu followed Han Xiao's attitude and ignored Xiao Quan. Xiao Quan could not help but feel more nervous.

"We're here, let's go in."

The door to the guest room opened, and Xiao Quan immediately saw Han Xiao sitting on the sofa with his legs crossed. He was staring at him calmly. Xiao Quan couldn't help but hold his breath, not even daring to breathe loudly.

"Xiao, Xiao Han, long time no see." He braced himself and greeted him, trying to ease the atmosphere.

"Call me Han Xiao," Han Xiao said lightly.

This was not a good sign, and Xiao Quan was frightened, so he could only change his words.

"You're alone?" Han Xiao raised his eyebrows and said, "Why is Overmera looking for me?"

Xiao Quan hurriedly worded his words and said carefully, "Han Xiao, father has been thinking about you and wants to see you. He hopes that you can go back, and he can explain everything that happened in the past."

Han Xiao did not say anything, but stared straight at Xiao Quan. Xiao Quan only felt that the gaze was full of pressure. He lowered his head subconsciously, and small beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.

"You want me to go over?" Han Xiao stood up and walked over in large strides, as if he was going to attack. Xiao Quan was pressured by the aura, and when he thought of Han Xiao's various deeds, a wave of panic arose. He shrank back like a quail, knocked over a chair, lost his balance and fell to the ground. He hurriedly wanted to get up, but suddenly a shadow shrouded him. Han Xiao had both hands in his pockets, bent over, and looked down at him. His eyes were like needles, piercing Xiao Quan's heart. He half knelt on the ground, not daring to move, and looked up with a panicked expression.

"I think you don't understand the situation. If you want to see me, ask Xiao Jin and the others to come over themselves!"

Han Xiao's tone was indifferent, and suddenly reached out his hand, touching Xiao Quan.

'It's over, he wants to kill me!'

Xiao Quan's face was full of panic, and his mind was blank.

His shoulder was suddenly grabbed by a hand, and there was a force that lifted him up.

Xiao Quan was pulled up, and Han Xiao patted his shoulder as if he was sweeping the dust off him. "Tell them what I said, word for word."

Huang Yu, who was waiting on the side, opened the door, extended his hand, and said expressionlessly, "Please."

Xiao Quan regained his senses, but he was still scared. He did not dare stay any longer and left as if he was running away.

Han Xiao sat back on the sofa and thought to himself, Overmera's visit is probably because they want to use their relationship as' family 'to get my help, but I can use them. If I let Overmera move to Sanctuary Three, there will be even more NPC resources here …

On the other side, after Xiao Quan left, he immediately reported Han Xiao's attitude to Xiao Jin, trembling in fear.

"He … he wants you to come over personally."

Xiao Jin's expression was uncertain, and he let out a long sigh. "This time, it's going to cost a lot …"

In the past, Han Xiao was wearing a mask, and the two sides did not know each other's background, so there was still room for negotiation. But now that he revealed his true identity, it was the same as shedding all pretense of cordiality. All the conflicts were put on the table, and Overmera was the weaker side, so they could only keep backing down.

Xiao Jin looked at Xiao Hai beside him and said with a deep voice, "You better prepare how to apologize and make up for it yourself!"

Then he slammed the door and left, leaving Xiao Hai in the room with a panicked expression.
